name: Kinetic Trust Limited
summary: Kinetic Trust Ltd. provides a comprehensive array of financial, advisory, and consulting services. The company's primary focus is on capital market investments, alongside offering guidance to clients for their own capital market activities in an advisory capacity. Furthermore, it delivers specialized project consultancy services, which include designing project financial patterns and creating detailed project reports. The firm was established on August 12, 1992, and its headquarters are situated in New Delhi, India.
